name: UCI School of Medicine Summer Online Research Program
what_you_do: Do a healthcare research project with a mentor, online, in a 3-week session. Students in higher grades get priority.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18 with a 3.3 unweighted GPA or higher. You should be interested in healthcare research.
pay_detail: $2,350 for each 3-week session. Limited scholarships are for low-income families at underserved Southern California high schools.
duration: 3 weeks. In 2026 the sessions were June 22 to July 10 and July 13 to July 31.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The page says the program typically closes to new applications by the end of January or the beginning of February. It reviews applications on a rolling basis.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Email your transcript to highschoolresearch@hs.uci.edu. An unofficial copy is fine. You then get a signed confirmation by email.
notes: For a scholarship you write an essay and give family tax information. Tax forms are due before acceptance. The page still mentions the 2025 program in its scholarship text, so ask the program to confirm the details.
